messages:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: compact owners list for streaming/chat reliability fixes (timeouts, partials, reconnect storms). Keep replies short.

sam: I'll own client retry defaults + SDK opt-ins. Target: Wed EOD. Acceptance: canary SDK shows <5% user latency regression and reduced retry_amplification_ratio.

lee: I'll do a KV TTL sweep and shard heat smoothing patch. Target: Thu. Acceptance: staging replay shows >30% reduction in cold-shard partials.

nina: I'll add session-level transient-circuit and partial_chunk_rate metric. Target: next Tue. Acceptance: canary trips on noisy sessions and partial rate drops.

ops-bot: Scheduled weekly recurrence detection job: Mondays 11:00 UTC. Outputs to /alerts/streaming-recurrence.csv.

maya: Rollout plan: internal canary (30m) -> canary ramp (1h) -> 3h prod ramp with health gates on partial_chunk_rate and session_stability_score.

sam: pushed SDK patch to internal-canary. CI green.

lee: replay results incoming by EOD; preliminary staging shows 36% drop in cache-related partials.

nina: infra PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/streaming/77. Adds tracing tags for chunk_seq and last_acked_offset.

maya: risks: backoff defaults may increase perceived retry wait for a small set; mitigation: opt-in flag + canary. Circuit misfires -> short TTL + smoke tests.

ops-bot: Reminder set: owners add one-line acceptance to ticket when done.
